item.title: visualstudio: Keep your investigation between sessions
item.description:
Visual Studio adds a standalone Markdown note for investigations and an opt-in Hot Exit preview that restores unsaved work in the next session. The post focuses on preserving work between sessions.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog
